title: Selective Semantic Evidence Retention
subtitle: Memory-efficient persistent semantic mapping
architecture_caption: Proposed framework for selective semantic evidence retention.
overview: This project investigates how persistent semantic mapping systems can selectively retain useful observation histories under constrained memory budgets.
current_progress: Implemented and evaluated initial retention baselines, including FIFO, reservoir sampling, and confidence-based selection. Current work focuses on characterizing the value of retained observations and evaluating memory allocation strategies.
